checks.name: Budget does not hold back campaigns that convert well
checks.label: Practitioner rule
checks.source: references/audit-check-sources.md, Impression share lost to budget and to rank
checks.looked_at: Search lost IS (budget), cost and conversions of each enabled campaign.
evidence: Enabled campaigns with a figure for Search lost IS (budget): 2. Left out because they use Maximize conversions or Maximize conversion value: 1. Judged: 1. Converting at or below 88.88: 1.

items.detail: Search lost IS (budget) 34.2%. Search impr. share 51.3%. Budget 240.00. Bid strategy: Manual CPC.

checks.threshold: A campaign is judged when the file gives a figure for Search lost IS (budget). The file writes '< 10%' for small shares, and those are read as no figure. It fails when its cost per conversion is at or below 88.88, which is the cost per conversion of the non brand enabled campaigns in the campaign report, judged in this audit.
checks.left_out: Left out by design: Plumbing | Water Heaters. Google says these strategies spend the full budget and Search lost IS (budget) does not apply to them.
checks.money_basis: an estimate of the spend the budget held back from campaigns that convert at or below the account's own cost per conversion: cost times Search lost IS (budget), divided by Search impr. share. It assumes the missed impressions would cost what the shown ones did. It is an upper bound, because the searches the ads missed usually convert worse than the ones they won. Where Search impr. share is missing, the campaign's whole cost is used
checks.fix: Raise the Plumbing | Emergency budget in steps, and only after the conversion fix in CT-04, so its cost per conversion is read on clean numbers. Watch Search lost IS (budget) and cost per conversion for two weeks after each step.

clear_waste.includes: Spend with no conversions on non brand search terms that spent at least the search term line (SQ-01), and on enabled keywords that spent at least the keyword line (KW-05).
clear_waste.leaves_out: Brand searches, searches and keywords below those lines, searches Google does not list, paused campaigns, and every exposed or held back amount. Campaign level spend with no conversions (BB-04) is left out because it holds the same spend.
notes: A search served by a flagged keyword is inside that keyword's cost, so it is counted once, as part of the keyword. 1,432.80 was removed this way.

assumptions: No target cost per conversion was given. BB-06 did not run, and BB-03, BB-04, KW-05, SQ-01 used the account's own cost per conversion as the line instead.
Brand terms used: northside. Brand campaigns: Brand. Brand rows were kept out of the lines in BB-03, BB-04, KW-05, SQ-01.
summary: The account converts, but two primary actions count the same lead form, so the campaigns that bid on conversions steer by inflated numbers. Fix that first. After it, the Emergency campaign is the clearest place for more budget, and the Hydro Jetting ad group needs a working ad.
